# onpager_team (Data Source)

Read one OnPager team through authorized configuration reads. Absence, ambiguity and denied reads are errors. Reads never modify configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onpager_team" "example" {
  name = "Operations"
}

output "team_id" {
  value = data.onpager_team.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Stable OnPager UUID. Configure exactly one identity selector. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID; computed when another selector is configured.
- `name` (String) Exact case-sensitive name, preserving whitespace. Configure exactly one identity selector. Maximum 4096 UTF-8 bytes; use `id` for longer stored names. Computed when another selector is configured.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Observed active state. Inactive objects remain readable; this data source never changes their state.

## Selection

Configure exactly one of `id` or `name`. Name matching is exact and
case-sensitive and preserves surrounding whitespace. Names remain reserved and
unique within the tenant, including inactive teams.

Name lookups use an exact server-side filter with `limit=2`. Zero matches,
multiple matches or `has_more` produce a diagnostic. The name is limited to 4096
UTF-8 bytes and the full JSON filter to 8192 bytes. UUID selection reads the
team directly and bypasses these filter limits. Results include only teams the
caller is authorized to read.

The unique match is read directly by UUID before its metadata is returned.

## Read behavior

Reads team metadata and active state, including inactive teams. Missing teams,
denied access, malformed responses and transport failures produce diagnostics.

## Permissions

Requires `teams.read` in the selected team or at tenant scope for personal
tokens and service accounts.
